posts.body_html:
Here's a really beautiful butterfly that I painstakingly followed around for a long time before getting a few shots worth posting! It was feasting on the nectar of S. leucophylla at first, but then went over to S. oreophila Clay Co, NC for another sip. It definitely looked intoxicated, but it didn't get munched. I can't say the same for its kin though, many traps in the collection are loaded with big butterflies unfortunately: the plants target the Beautiful, the bad, the beneficial, and the UGLY:


something must have tried to nab this butterfly, some parts of the wings look damaged. Maybe that's why this butterfly stopped by to have a drink, to chill out after being chased by a lizard or something:
